payload.title: Persist incremental transcription through timeline edits and resume interruptions
acceptance: Every completed audio window is durably inserted through the canonical runtime exactly once, before the next window completes.
Timeline edits do not discard or abort ongoing transcription; source-bound words are mapped against current clips without overwriting unrelated edits.
Completed windows survive interruption and retry resumes missing work; bounded automatic recovery retains published words.
Tests cover edits during transcription, incremental publication, duplicate replay, cancellation/recovery and canonical state reads.
